description: T-4757: sheet names with a mark after the first character, beyond T-4446's Mn/Me probe. Sheets: a+U+0301 (Mn, B1 11), क+U+093E (Mc, alphabetic, B1 17), x+U+0F3E (Mc, not alphabetic, B1 13), the cell-shaped B1+U+0301 (B1 19) and the R1C1-shaped C1+U+0301 (B1 23). Each is read through a quoted reference with its FORMULATEXT, and through INDIRECT of the unquoted and quoted text. Predictions, committed before the fill: every quoted reference reads its B1; FORMULATEXT writes a+U+0301, क+U+093E, x+U+0F3E and B1+U+0301 unquoted (a mark after the first character joins the name; B1+U+0301 is not a cell, as T-4446 showed for a defined name) and C1+U+0301 quoted (R1C1-shaped); INDIRECT of the unquoted text reads B1 for all but C1+U+0301 (#REF!); INDIRECT of the quoted text reads B1 for all five.
